title: EmDash and the Design system button: a new Tracy site's first rebuild names no class it never wrote, a press never waits for a cold page, and a Tracy SaaS site older than the slot reader is told to update
steps: S1: node --test tests/ds-slot-no-shipped-pins.test.mjs (cwd packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-base); node --test test/emdash-quickstart.test.mjs (cwd packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation). Tracy Business's own class fix is not in this release: another line released 1.7.13 first and develop's theme wins; it is re-applied on top as the next version.
expect: S1: Tracy Base 0.5.0 ships no literal radius in the shadcn parts no page draws (each reads --ds-card-radius / --ds-input-radius / --ds-btn-radius with the value it pinned as the fallback), and the fleet's emdash_build_image dates the unpacked source at the unpack (a zip whose files carry a time seven hours ahead unpacks with none in the future).

S2: slot-pins does not judge a class string with `&` that the last build holds escaped as `&`, still judges it once changed; site.restart reads the first answer to its end and renders the home page once more before it answers, and a failed warm-up changes nothing.

S3: an apply whose page load takes longer than the door's wait answers seen null without waiting (the load keeps running and ends by itself); a load within the wait says true / false, a failed one null; SEEN_WAIT_MS is 1500. Tracy SaaS 1.4.5, 1.4.9 and 1.4.10 get TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE need 1.4.12, 1.4.12 gets emdash-tracy-saas (develop's 1.4.10, #1013, came without the reader).

S4: the where-map names 1.7.13 with a verifiedReleases record for 1.7.12, template-profiles has rows tracy-business/emdash-0.x 1.7.13 and tracy-saas/emdash-0.x 1.4.10, and the committed lib/index.js of tracy-site-build-emdash carries the `&` look-up and the warm-up.
evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-walkthrough-2026-10-11/README.md findings 9 and 11 (before); tasks/evidence/ds-fix-em-2026-10-11/README.md (cause, timing table, release build).
fence: No stand, no model, no database. The release itself (ja-products) is not published here: ~/tracy-bench-work/RELEASE-EMDASH-BUSINESS-DS.sh is for a person to run. The door's timing on the stand needs images rebuilt from this branch (integrator).
